english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something strikingly weird or bizarre.
This is the all-purpose choice for a person who behaves unusually or strangely.
This is the all-purpose choice for something odd or idiosyncratic, without necessarily implying that it is cute.
This is the all-purpose choice when the person’s individual behavior or experience seems eccentric or odd.
This is the all-purpose choice for something strangely odd or unsettling.
Choose this for something conspicuously odd, eccentric, or bizarre rather than merely unusual.
Use this when something seems distinctly odd, weird, or unconventional rather than merely unexpected.
Use this when the atypical thing seems odd, strange, or unsettling rather than merely uncommon.
Use this when singular means strange or unusual in behavior, appearance, or circumstances.
Use this for something eccentric or unusual, and in context for a person or thing that seems suspicious or not quite right.
Pick this for strange or off-putting behavior that feels unsettling rather than explicitly sexual.
Choose this when the behavior, result, or situation is oddly contrary or vexing rather than simply stubborn.
Use this when a person's behavior seems odd or strange, rather than making a clinical judgment about mental health.

examples.english: They were wearing a dinosaur costume on the street—it was truly bizarre.
examples.traditional: 佢竟然喺街上面着住件恐龍裝，真係古怪。
